Once customized, use workflows to transition your records into their appropriate next stages throughout your risk management lifecycles.

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] Workflows have already been set up for use with your records or artifacts.[^1]
- [x] You are assigned a role with sufficient permissions to view workflows.[^2]

:::

## View all workflow executions

{{< include /guide/workflows/_view-workflow-executions.qmd >}}

### Export workflow executions {#export-workflow-executions}

Click **Export** on the Workflows timeline to download the runs in your current search and filters as a CSV file named `global-workflows.csv`. The file downloads automatically once it's ready. Large exports may take a few moments to generate.

An export can include up to 250,000 runs. If your search and filters match more, the export stops with an error and you need to narrow your filters before trying again.

Each row in the file is one workflow run, with these columns:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| **Record ID** | The ID of the record the run belongs to. For artifact and risk tier assessment runs, the ID of the parent record. |
| **Record** | The name of that record. |
| **Record Version** | The record version the run belongs to, for example `2`, marked `(Primary)` or `(Retired)` where that applies.[^3] |
| **Record Archived** | `Yes` if the record is archived, otherwise `No`. |
| **Artifact ID** | The artifact's ID for artifact runs. Blank for record runs and risk tier assessment runs. |
| **Artifact** | The artifact's title for artifact runs, or the risk tier assessment's name for risk tier assessment runs. Blank for record runs. |
| **Workflow Type** | `Record`, `Artifact`, or `Risk Tiering`. |
| **Workflow** | The name of the workflow. |
| **Workflow Archived** | `Yes` if the workflow is archived, otherwise `No`. |
| **Execution ID** | The ID of the run. |
| **Workflow Assignee** | The run's assigned stakeholder, if one is set.[^4] |
| **Workflow Assignee Type** | The stakeholder role of the workflow assignee. |
| **Status** | The run's status: `scheduled`, `active`, `waiting`, `finished`, or `aborted`. |
| **Started At (UTC)** | When the run started. |
| **Expected End At (UTC)** | When the run is expected to end. |
| **Finished At (UTC)** | When the run finished. |
| **Workflow State** | The workflow state the run is in, set by the workflow's **Workflow State Change** steps. Finished and aborted runs keep the last state they were set to. Runs that were never set to a state show `No state set`.[^5] |
| **Record Stage** | The current stage of the record the run belongs to.[^6] For artifact and risk tier assessment runs, the stage of the parent record. Blank when the record has no stage. |
| **Artifact Status** | For artifact runs, the artifact's status. For risk tier assessment runs, the assessment's review stage, or `Draft` or `Archived` for an assessment that has no review stage. Blank for record runs. |

Dates and times are in UTC.
